## feature

None

## fix

### FL now counts =/X CIGAR operations

```
level: high
```

#### reason

The regression suite covers the helper with =/X ops and a bam-level qc-summary test, and the fixed CLI reports fl=668/984 on the real workflow bam that exposed the defect.

#### description

```
type: [statistic, text]
```

1. `sum_match_del_skip_cigar` now sums M/=/X/D/N (all reference-consuming ops); previously `=`/`X` were omitted.
2. cs-tagged bams (cs-tagger output) carry `=`/`X` instead of `M`, so full-length reads never tallied in qc-summary or annotate FL stats.
3. Verified on the wps_1012 gs9973 sample-1 cs bam: fl 0 → 668 of 984 reads (the exact full-span count pysam reported at diagnosis).

#### before

Any bam with `=`/`X` CIGARs reported fl=0 and fl_pct=0.0 in qc-summary and the annotate FL stats.

#### after

Full-length spans written as `=`/`X` tally identically to `M`.

#### evidence

```
level: high
type: [statistic]
```

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}

- `pixi run -e dev sam-tagger qc-summary -i .../T22610201601-GS9973-1...circular.cs.bam --config /tmp/qc_cfg.csv` → `total_reads: 984 fl: 668 fl_pct: 0.6789` (was fl=0 at v0.5.0).
- New tests: `test_sum_match_del_skip_cigar_equal_diff_ops`, `test_qc_summary_fl_counts_equal_and_diff_cigar` (28= and 14=2X12= tally; 24= does not).

:::

### error-stats --prefix no longer drops the last dotted segment

```
level: high
```

#### reason

Path resolution is now literal and unit-tested for dotted stems; the previous behavior is documented as replaced.

#### description

```
type: [text]
```

1. `ErrorStatsOutputPaths.from_args` appends `.{ext}` to the prefix verbatim.
2. Previously a dotted prefix (`Sample.Ref`) lost its last segment (`Sample.error.parquet`) via `Path.stem`.

#### before

`--prefix dir/Sample.Ref` produced `dir/Sample.error.parquet` — silent output-name corruption for `{sample}.{ref}` pipelines.

#### after

`--prefix dir/Sample.Ref` produces `dir/Sample.Ref.error.parquet`. Behavior change: a suffix-like tail is no longer stripped, so `--prefix stats.tsv` now yields `stats.tsv.error.parquet` (was `stats.error.parquet`); noted in the release notes.

#### evidence

```
level: high
type: [text]
```

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}

- New: `test_error_paths_from_prefix_dotted_stem`; updated: `test_error_paths_from_prefix_with_suffix` (literal semantics).
- Suite: 153 passed (150 before), `ruff check` clean.

:::

## caveat

### the prefix change is observable behavior, not a pure fix

```
level: medium
```

#### reason

Callers that relied on suffix stripping see different output names after the upgrade; the release notes carry the one-line migration.

#### description

```
type: [text]
```

Pass a prefix WITHOUT an extension-like tail unless the tail is meant to be part of every output name.

#### evidence

```
level: unknown
type: [text]
```

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}

None

### the house formatter swept eleven out-of-scope files

```
status: wrong
```

#### description

```
type: [text]
```

1. `pixi run format` reformatted 15 files; only five were in scope.
2. The repo is not format-clean under the current ruff, so a blanket format run rewrites unrelated history.
3. We reverted the eleven out-of-scope files before committing; the better action is `ruff format <changed-files>` only.

#### evidence

```
level: high
type: [text]
```

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}

`git status --short` after the revert shows exactly the five in-scope files plus the new plan.

:::
